gr_list.description: Revenue Attribution: outcome-bazli sabit deger atfetme, 4 boyut (agent/saat/outcome/instance)

plan.summary: RI-3.4 Revenue Attribution: PG-only compute engine. wa_conversation_outcomes + wa_response_times + wa_agent_metrics'den outcome-bazli sabit TL degerleriyle revenue attribution hesaplar. 4 boyut: agent (agent basina revenue), hour (saat bazli), outcome (outcome tipi x revenue), instance (WA instance bazli). Sonuclar wa_revenue_attribution tablosuna yazilir. POST compute + GET read pattern.
plan.q_intent: RI-3.4 Revenue Attribution — conversation outcome'lara parasal deger atfetme, agent/saat bazli revenue korelasyonu. Sabit deger atama, 4 boyut, sadece PG.
plan.interview_notes: Q confirmed: (1) Sabit deger atama (sector AOV degil, fixed TL per outcome), (2) 4 boyut: agent+saat+outcome+instance, (3) Sadece PG - MSSQL round-trip yok, mevcut PG verisi yeterli. EbruModa MSSQL'de siparis/odeme verisi yok.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/insights/compute/revenue-attribution endpointi EbruModa icin 4 boyutta revenue hesaplar ve wa_revenue_attribution tablosuna yazar
GET /api/ops/insights/revenue-attribution/{tenantId} endpointi tum boyutlari doner (opsiyonel instanceId + dimension filter)
Her boyut satirinda total_conversations, attributed_revenue, avg_revenue ve outcome breakdown mevcut

files_changed.change: New RI-3.4 PG-only revenue attribution engine
Added revenue attribution upsert/read/delete + outcome/hourly query methods
Added Revenue Attribution DTOs and query helper models
Added DI registration + 2 endpoints (compute + read) + discovery entries

verification_questions.question: Does the PG-only compute correctly join wa_conversation_outcomes with wa_response_times to extract hour-of-day for the hour dimension?
Is the agent dimension correctly derived from wa_agent_metrics outcome counts multiplied by fixed values (not double-counting with outcome dimension)?
Does the ON CONFLICT upsert handle the composite key (tenant_id, instance_id, dimension, dimension_key) correctly for re-computation?

intentional_exclusions: MSSQL data fetch (no order data exists)
Dynamic value configuration per tenant (deferred to RI-6)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All PG query errors bubble up. Empty outcomes returns 404. No MSSQL batch risk since PG-only.

aha_moments.user_pain: Hangi agent en cok gelir getiriyor bilinmiyor, performans sadece mesaj sayisiyla olculuyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Agent basina attributed revenue gosterilir, en yuksek gelirli agent listede uste cikar
aha_moments.aha_moment: Agent X'in 50 satis x 500 TL = 25,000 TL getirdigi gorulunce prime/bonus kararini verir

aha_moments.user_pain: Saatlik gelir dagilimi bilinmiyor, tum saatlere esit kaynak ayriliyordu
aha_moments.suggestion: Saat bazli revenue dagilimiyla peak revenue saatleri tespit edilir
aha_moments.aha_moment: 14:00-16:00 arasi toplam 8,000 TL revenue gorulunce o saatlere ekstra agent yonlendirir

aha_moments.suggestion: offer_lost ve no_response'in tahmini deger kaybini gosterir
aha_moments.aha_moment: Ayda 163 kayip firsat x 50 TL = 8,150 TL kayip gorulunce follow-up stratejisini degistirir

aha_moments.suggestion: computed_at + total_conversations sayisi ile rapor guvenilirligi gosterilir
aha_moments.aha_moment: 1,190 konusman analiz edildigini ve 2 saat once hesaplandigini gorur, rapora guven duyar

aha_moments.user_pain: 4 farkli boyutta veri karisik ve okumasi zor
aha_moments.suggestion: dimension filtresi ile tek boyut secilir, summary satiri toplam revenue gosterir
aha_moments.aha_moment: GET parametresiyle sadece agent boyutunu gorur, toplam 45,000 TL attributed revenue aninda gorur
